title: Headcount sync 1:1 prep scratchpad
content:
Quick prep notes for my 1:1 with Priya (hiring manager) - aim to get alignment on remaining Q1/Q2 hires, unblock interview loops, and close decisions on 2 role shifts. informal scratchpad: expect to iterate in meeting and copy final action items to people-ops/Headcount Q2 confluence page.

Meeting context and goals:
- Time: 30m 1:1 (goal: decide final moves on 4 open reqs, confirm interviewers, agree next steps for 3 active candidates)
- Background: Q2 budget mostly approved, but need sign-off on 2 role reclassifications (senior -> staff for infra infra-ml), and confirm backfill timing for two IC departures.
- Primary asks from me: prioritization (A/B/C), interview loop bandwidth (who can cover), decision on leveling change for infra lead.

Current open roles (summary):
- ENG-INFRA-004: Inference Runtime Engineer (priority A) - req created Q1, hiring mgr: Priya. 4 active pipelines (2 onsite-ready). Candidate highlights: C-782 (onsite), C-790 (take-home), referee checks pending. Need go/no-go today to book final loop.
- ENG-APPLIED-007: Applied ML Engineer (priority B) - slower funnel, would like to open to L3/L4 hybrid if we lean on stronger mentoring.
- ENG-PLAT-002: Platform SRE (priority A) - must replace headcount vacated Feb. Candidate pool good; interviewers overloaded next 2 weeks.
- ENG-DATA-005: Data Eng (priority C) - can defer to Q3 if needed.

Interview loop status & next steps (detailed):
- C-782 (ENG-INFRA-004): onsite scheduled but needs one more internal interviewer (runtime infra). Action: ask Priya if Ravi or Marcus can join onsite loop next Tue. If yes -> finalize offer slide.
- C-790 (ENG-INFRA-004): waiting on take-home review (Sofia). TODO: nudge Sofia + estimate 48h review. If pass -> arrange panel.
- C-413 (ENG-PLAT-002): passed onsites but compensation expectation high. Ask for approval to stretch offer by +10% band vs typical for urgent backfill. Linked jira: JIRA-HR-452.
- C-601 (APL-007): low signal, recommend closing outbound and re-open req in March unless Priya pushes.

Blockers to surface in 1:1:
- Budget nuance: finance approved headcount but flagged team-level uplift for staff roles; need explicit approval for Staff-level compensation delta. (Point to finance email thread in slack).
- Interviewer bandwidth: Platform + Serving Runtime teams have concurrent launches (release v0.9) - may need to borrow interviewers from other eng squads or hire external interviewer panel.
- Role scoping: infra lead asks to shift one infra hire from Senior -> Staff due to scope expansion (kernel work + cross-team ownership). Need explicit sign-off to reclass.

Proposed asks / recommendations for Priya (what to decide in the 1:1):
1) Approve moving ENG-INFRA-004 to Staff-level (senior->staff) to capture required scope. If no approval, proceed to fill Senior but schedule rapid follow-on promotion window.
2) Greenlight offer band exception for C-413 (Platform SRE) up to +10% for urgent backfill; People Ops will draft rationale.
3) Confirm who can cover interview loop for ENG-PLAT-002 (list: Marcus, Leila, Ravi) or approve vendor interview panel.
4) Defer ENG-DATA-005 to Q3 if no compelling candidate pipelines this month.

Decision matrix (quick):
- If Priya approves Staff reclass + comp exception -> prioritize C-782 / C-413 and aim to extend offers within 72h.
- If Priya declines both -> prioritize fill of ENG-PLAT-002 with internal candidate or reopen wider pool for Platform.

Draft agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: quick status (open reqs and blockers)
- 5-12m: deep dive on ENG-INFRA-004 and candidate C-782/C-790 -> decision
- 12-20m: discuss ENG-PLAT-002 compensation ask (C-413) and interviewer coverage
- 20-25m: quick call on role scoping reclass for infra lead
- 25-30m: confirm action items, owners, due dates

Action items to capture during/after meeting (I'll own drafting final notes and updating confluence):
- Priya: decision on Staff reclass for ENG-INFRA-004 (due: EOD today) - assign as "Priya"
- Ravi: confirm interviewer availability for C-782 (due: tomorrow noon) - assign as "Ravi Menon"
- Sofia: finish take-home review for C-790 (due: +48h) - assign as "Sofia Alvarez"
- People Ops (me): prepare compensation exception memo for C-413 + submit to finance (due: 48h) - assign as "Jordan Patel"
- Hiring panel: if shortage, approve using vendor interview panel (vendor: CodeScreen / HirePanel) (decision due: EOW)

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize risk of losing C-782 if we delay offer (candidate has other on-sites this week).
- If Priya is hesitant on Staff reclass, propose temporary Title: Senior with immediate promotion review after 3 months tied to delivery milestones.
- Keep the ask for +10% comp framed as a one-off for urgent backfill; show candidate scarcity data (slack thread + hiring metrics).

Follow-ups after meeting (post-meeting template I'll paste into confluence):
- Summary of decisions (1-2 bullets)
- Updated pipeline table with statuses + owners + due dates
- Links to interviews, take-home, and referee notes
- Final action items with owners & due dates (copy here and ping on slack)

Other quick metrics to have ready if asked:
- Time-to-fill for infra roles average: 50 days (last 6 months)
- Offer acceptance rate for infra/platform: 62% last quarter
- Number of active offers outstanding: 2 (one for infra, one for platform)

Scratchpad TODOs (personal):
- Pull last comp comps for Platform SRE (benchmark vs market) -> include in memo (data source: Radford + internal bands)
- Update candidate tracker row for C-782 with interviewer list + notes
- Draft short message to finance channel explaining comp exception rationale (copy Priya)

End of scratchpad - will convert to formal 1:1 notes and confluence update after meeting. Keep this doc as ephemeral working notes; aim to delete/rename when finalized.
